components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The main action in a surface. Currently Amber Ink; migrating to Kiln Orange.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 44px; padding: 0 15px; border: 1px solid var(--workflow-ink, #995a21); border-radius: 8px; background: var(--workflow-ink, #995a21); color: #fffaf2; font: 600 13px/1.15 'Instrument Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: -0.01em; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgb(68 39 18 / 18%); cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 140ms ease, transform 140ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #824817; border-color: #824817; } .ds-btn-primary:active { background: #6f3d15; border-color: #6f3d15; box-shadow: none; transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--orange, #ed6c34); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Supporting action on Chrome Paper with a hairline and Chrome Lift.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 44px; padding: 0 15px; border: 1px solid var(--chrome-rule, #e1dad1); border-radius: 8px; background: var(--chrome-surface, #faf8f4); color: var(--ink, #1c1815); font: 600 13px/1.15 'Instrument Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: -0.01em; box-shadow: 0 2px 5px rgb(26 25 22 / 4%), 0 12px 24px -14px rgb(26 25 22 / 25%); cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 140ms ease, border-color 140ms ease, transform 140ms ease; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { border-color: color-mix(in srgb, #ed6c34 55%, #e1dad1); background: color-mix(in srgb, #faf8f4 86%, #ed6c34); } .ds-btn-secondary:active { transform: translateY(1px); box-shadow: none; } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--orange, #ed6c34); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Quiet Button
components.description: Transparent tool action; faint accent wash on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-quiet { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 44px; padding: 0 15px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 8px; background: transparent; color: var(--ink-quiet, #57514a); font: 600 13px/1.15 'Instrument Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: -0.01em; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 140ms ease, color 140ms ease; } .ds-btn-quiet:hover { background: color-mix(in srgb, #faf8f4 88%, #ed6c34); color: var(--ink, #1c1815); } .ds-btn-quiet:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--orange, #ed6c34); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Destructive Button
components.description: Oxide text and border; a 10% wash on hover, never a solid red fill.
components.css: .ds-btn-destructive { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 44px; padding: 0 15px; border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, #8a3828 38%, #e1dad1); border-radius: 8px; background: transparent; color: var(--destructive, #8a3828); font: 600 13px/1.15 'Instrument Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 140ms ease; } .ds-btn-destructive:hover { background: color-mix(in srgb, #8a3828 10%, transparent); } .ds-btn-destructive:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--orange, #ed6c34); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Search Trigger
components.description: Centred top search field that opens the Library/Search panel.
components.css: .ds-search { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; width: 360px; min-height: 44px; padding: 4px 16px; border: 1px solid var(--chrome-rule, #e1dad1); border-radius: 13px; background: var(--chrome-surface, #faf8f4); color: var(--ink-quiet, #57514a); font: 13px/1.2 'Instrument Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; text-align: left; box-shadow: 0 1px 1px rgba(28,24,21,0.05), 0 3px 10px -6px rgba(28,24,21,0.22); cursor: pointer; } .ds-search:hover { border-color: var(--orange-deep, #ad4318); color: var(--ink, #1c1815); } .ds-search:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--orange, #ed6c34); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-search-label { flex: 1; } .ds-search-kbd { color: var(--ink-faint, #70695f); font: 11px 'Instrument Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; border: 0; background: transparent; }

components.name: World Object Card (Ink)
components.description: Signature archival index card for one identity; solid quiet edge means settled Ink.
components.html:
CharacterInk

Mara Venn

Keeps the gate on Blackwater Road. Knows what happened to the bells, and will not say it twice.

Glass Church · 3 threads
components.css: .ds-card { display: flex; flex-direction: column; width: 300px; border: 1px solid var(--ink-faint, #70695f); border-radius: 14px; background: var(--card, #fbf9f4); color: var(--ink, #1c1815); box-shadow: 0 1px 1px rgba(28,24,21,0.06), 0 10px 24px -12px rgba(28,24,21,0.32); font-family: 'Instrument Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; overflow: hidden; transition: box-shadow 180ms ease-out, border-color 180ms ease-out; } .ds-card:hover, .ds-card:focus-within { border-color: var(--orange, #ed6c34); box-shadow: 0 1px 1px rgba(28,24,21,0.06), 0 10px 24px -12px rgba(28,24,21,0.32), 0 0 0 2px rgba(237,108,52,0.38); } .ds-card-top { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; min-height: 42px; padding: 12px 20px 10px; } .ds-card-family, .ds-card-maturity { color: var(--ink-quiet, #57514a); font: 500 10px/1.4 'Instrument Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: .1em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-card-maturity { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 7px; } .ds-card-maturity i { width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--ink, #1c1815); } .ds-card-body { padding: 4px 20px 18px; } .ds-card-body h2 { margin: 0; font: 600 30px/1 'Cormorant Garamond', Georgia, serif; letter-spacing: -.018em; } .ds-card-body p { margin: 12px 0 0; font: 400 13px/1.65 'Iowan Old Style', Charter, Georgia, serif; } .ds-card-bottom { display: flex; align-items: center; min-height: 44px; padding: 0 20px; border-top: 1px solid var(--rule, #ddd6c7); color: var(--ink-quiet, #57514a); font-size: 10px; }

narrative.overview:
Relic looks like a carefully kept record of a world that is still being written. The interface is archival paper: warm ivory grounds, near-black ink and thin precise rules. It stays quiet so that the world's own material (names, prose, portraits, places) carries the colour and the attention. Nothing is decorated to look important. Settled things look settled because they are fully drawn and calm, not because they are badged.

The archive is alive, so provenance and state are always legible. You can tell established truth (Ink) from provisional material (Pencil) by shape alone. Dates, sources and counts are set as system metadata. Selection and the live signal are marked with one scarce orange. Type does the heavy lifting. A literary serif voices the world, and a clean grotesque runs the instruments around it.

Density is calm but working. The archive is read at length in Focus and scanned fast at the table, so hierarchy comes from scale, weight, spacing and placement before colour. The system is light-paper only today. The low-light treatment for play is an open decision (see Do's and Don'ts).
keyCharacteristics: Warm paper grounds and near-black ink. The world has the colour; the interface has paper and rules.
One scarce orange accent for where you are: selection, focus, live.
A serif voice for world content and a sans voice for instruments.
Truth is carried by edge shape (dashed Pencil, solid Ink), never by colour alone.
Tactile, matte, shallow depth. Never a drop-shadow costume.
Generous 44px touch targets everywhere, including dense chrome.

rules.name: The Paper and Rules Rule
rules.body: The world is the thing with colour in it; the interface is paper and rules. Chrome never competes with a portrait, a place image or a card tint.

rules.name: The One Signal Rule
rules.body: Orange means "this is where you are" (selected, focused, live). If more than one thing on a screen is orange for unrelated reasons, one of them is wrong.

rules.name: The Never Colour Alone Rule
rules.body: Every state that colour marks (truth, selection, proposal, status) also reads through a word, a shape or an edge.

rules.name: The Two Voices Rule
rules.body: World content is set in the serifs, and instruments are set in Instrument Sans. A control label in Cormorant, or a character summary in sans, breaks the archive.

rules.name: The No Fantasy Display Rule
rules.body: No decorative blackletter, runic or "medieval" faces. The archive is literary, not costumed.

rules.name: The Matte Paper Rule
rules.body: Never a drop-shadow costume. No glows, no coloured shadows and no blur-heavy glass. If a surface needs to stand out more, raise it one tier or change its paper tone.

rules.name: The Selection Is Not Elevation Rule
rules.body: Selection adds the orange edge and halo. It never changes border style, and on its own it never raises a card.

rules.name: The Interrupted Edge Rule
rules.body: A dashed edge means not settled. It belongs to Pencil maturity, proposals (2px dashed, offset 5px) and spatial collections, and nothing else. Never use dashes as decoration.

dos: Do let world content carry the colour. Keep chrome in the paper and ink neutrals.
Do mark Pencil with a dashed edge and Ink with a solid, quiet edge. Spell out the maturity word where space allows.
Do reserve orange for selection, focus and live state. Use orange-deep wherever orange must carry text or a fill.
Do set world content in the serifs and every instrument in Instrument Sans.
Do keep every interactive target at least 44px, including dense card actions and Stage controls.
Do honour prefers-reduced-motion and data-relic-motion="reduced". Motion uses 120ms (feedback), 240ms (disclosure) and 320ms (spatial) on cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1).
Do meet WCAG 2.2 AA contrast in every role combination, including text on paper tints and orange.
donts: Don't add new uses of the amber workflow colours. Orange is canonical, and amber migrates when touched.
Don't use colour as the only carrier of truth, selection, proposal or status.
Don't use dashed borders for anything that is not unsettled.
Don't use glows, coloured shadows, glassmorphism or heavy blur. Depth is matte paper.
Don't use decorative fantasy display type.
Don't flatten hierarchy into uniform 14px-medium SaaS text. Scale, weight and the two voices make the hierarchy.

Don't treat a dark theme as decided. Open decision: live play happens in dim rooms, so Stage must be readable at low light. That treatment (a dim Stage mode or a full night theme) has not been designed. Until it is, light paper is the only theme.
